## Context
Explain the project context, scope boundary, and the problem this PR addresses.

## What Changed
Describe the main changes in a technical narrative. Group related changes and name key files or artifacts.

## Why It Matters
Explain impact on developer workflow, maintainability, quality, or governance.

## Risks and Trade-offs
List known risks, limitations, and explicit trade-offs introduced by this change.

## Validation
State how this was validated. For docs/template PRs, include consistency checks and affected artifacts.

## Follow-ups
List concrete next actions, if any.
